title: Analysis of Revenue Growth for Product Lines Over Four Quarters

questions.question: Based on the data in the provided chart, which product generated the highest sales in Q3? Choose the correct product name.
questions.solution:
To analyze the revenue growth for Product X over the quarters, we can summarize its growth as follows:

  • Q1: \$12,000
  • Q2: \$15,000
  • Q3: \$17,000
  • Q4: \$20,000

The growth from Q1 to Q4 can be calculated using the formula:

Growth = \left(\frac{\text{Revenue in Q4} - \text{Revenue in Q1}}{\text{Revenue in Q1}}\right) \times 100 = \left(\frac{20000 - 12000}{12000}\right) \times 100 = \frac{8000}{12000} \times 100 = 66.67\%

Therefore, the revenue growth for Product X from Q1 to Q4 is approximately 66.67%.
questions.answer: Product X's revenue growth from Q1 to Q4 is approximately 66.67%.

questions.solution:
